name: AWS Cost Explorer Query
purpose: Query AWS Cost Explorer for cost and usage data by time range, service, region, granularity, and cost metric.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: AmortizedCost | UnblendedCost | BlendedCost — default AmortizedCost

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: full AWS service name e.g. 'Amazon EC2' — empty for all services

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: MONTHLY | DAILY | HOURLY — default MONTHLY

parameters.name: account-id
parameters.description: AWS account ID or empty

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 30 days ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: cost allocation tag filter or empty

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region or empty for all regions

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context

name: Azure Cost Management Query

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: ActualCost | AmortizedCost — default ActualCost

parameters.name: service

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Monthly | Daily — default Monthly

parameters.name: subscriptions
parameters.description: Azure subscription name or empty

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 30 days ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Azure profile name from Cloud Profile context

name: AWS CloudWatch Metrics Query
purpose: Query AWS CloudWatch for infrastructure metrics — CPU, memory, disk, network — with dimension and threshold filtering.

parameters.name: metric_namespace
parameters.description: CloudWatch namespace e.g. AWS/EC2, AWS/RDS, AWS/Lambda

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: CloudWatch metric e.g. CPUUtilization, FreeStorageSpace, Errors

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: specific instance ID, DB identifier, or resource name — empty for all

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: aggregation period in seconds e.g. 3600 for 1h, 86400 for 1d — default 3600

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Average | Maximum | Sum — default Average

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: threshold condition e.g. >80, <20 — empty if no threshold

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 24h ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region or empty for default region

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context

name: Azure Monitor Metrics Query
purpose: Query Azure Monitor for infrastructure metrics with resource, aggregation, and threshold filtering.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Azure resource type e.g. vm, sql, functions, aks

parameters.name: resource-group
parameters.description: Azure resource group name or empty

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Azure metric name e.g. Percentage CPU, Available Memory Bytes

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: specific resource name or empty for all in group

parameters.name: aggregation
parameters.description: Average | Maximum — default Average

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: time window e.g. 24h, 7d — default 24h

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: threshold condition e.g. >80 — empty if no threshold

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: Azure subscription name or empty

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Azure profile name from Cloud Profile context

name: AWS CloudTrail Event Query
purpose: Query AWS CloudTrail for historical API events — who did what, when, and from where — with actor, resource, time, and error-code filtering.

parameters.name: event_source
parameters.description: AWS service source e.g. ec2.amazonaws.com, s3.amazonaws.com — empty for any service

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: CloudTrail API event name e.g. StopInstances, DeleteBucket — ONE event per step

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: IAM username or ARN who performed the action — empty for any user

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 30 days ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region — empty for all regions

parameters.name: resource_name
parameters.description: specific resource name to filter events — empty for all

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: resource type e.g. AWS::EC2::Instance — empty for all

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: source IP address filter — empty for all IPs

parameters.name: error_code
parameters.description: error code for failed events e.g. AccessDenied — empty for all

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context
